result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Gusto is my top recommendation**\. It offers a good balance of ease of use, automatic payroll tax filing, employee benefits, and HR tools without being overly complicated.

However, the best choice depends on how many employees you have, your budget, and whether you already use accounting software.

(Best overall)

# \$49/mo + \$6/person

- Easy to use, even for first-time employers.
- Automatic payroll tax calculations and filings.
- Employee onboarding, benefits and direct deposit.
- Employee self-service portal.

Best for: Businesses with 1–50 employees.

[Visit Gusto](https://gusto.com/)
